blocks.text: Anmore home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Anmore with a median price of $2,725,000 (the middle half sold between $1,801,000 and $3,387,500), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 94.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. blocks.text: Anmore houses against the rest of Port Moody

Anmore is the most expensive of the 8 Port Moody sub-areas with five or more house sales: $2,725,000 from 11 sales, against $1,870,000 for all 111 Port Moody houses, a difference of $855,000 or 46%. The next in line is Belcarra at $2,593,000 (6 sales).

The reason is land. The median Anmore lot is 43,560 square feet, one acre, against 6,943 square feet for Port Moody as a whole, which is 6.3 times as much. The $542 a square foot is below the $589 Port Moody median even though the price is higher, which fits a price that includes a lot far bigger than the city's, and the $2,725,000 median implies a house of about 5,030 square feet (a rough figure; one median divided by another is only approximate). The median build year is 2008, against 1992 for Port Moody, and the typical house has 4 bedrooms.

Anmore takes longer and gives up more. Houses took 28 days to sell against 23 in Port Moody, closed at 94.0% of the last list price against 96.6%, and none of the 11 sold above list while 8% of Port Moody houses did. The middle half of Anmore sales spanned $1,801,000 to $3,387,500, a band $1,586,500 wide, about 2.7 times the $590,000 band for Port Moody, so one Anmore sale says little about the next. No quarter of the year had five Anmore sales, so there are no quarterly medians.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Anmore?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 26 houses listed in Anmore. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Anmore a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: Anmore houses sold at a sales ratio of 12% in October 2026, a balanced market on the reports’ scale (under 12% favours buyers, over 20% favours sellers).

faq.q: How many houses sold in Anmore from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Anmore accounted for 6 of the 64 houses sold across Port Moody from June to October 2026.

faq.q: What did houses in Anmore sell for?
faq.a: The median house sale in Anmore was $2,725,000, across 11 sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Anmore?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Why are Anmore houses dearer than the rest of Port Moody?
faq.a: Mostly lot size. The median Anmore lot among the 11 houses that sold was 43,560 square feet, one acre, against 6,943 for Port Moody overall, and the median price was $2,725,000 against $1,870,000.

faq.q: Do Anmore houses sell above asking?
faq.a: None of the 11 did in the last 12 months. The median sale was 94.0% of the last list price after 28 days, compared with 96.6% after 23 days across Port Moody.
